Read `CLAUDE.md` (the project rules) and `AGENTS.md` (the agent guide) at the
root of this repository before making any change. Key points: never fit on the
live record, test every model change before it ships, never hand-edit
bot-written files or `dashboard.html`, standard library only, and open a pull
request rather than pushing to `main` (a push to `main` deploys the live site).
